name: Wrexham University

sources.title: How to apply - Wrexham University
sources.notes: Verbatim: 'Once you've successfully fulfilled the conditions of your offer, Wrexham University's Immigration Compliance team will be in contact with you to arrange a compliance interview.' 'If your compliance interview is successful and the course fees have been paid, the Immigration Compliance team will then issue you with a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) letter.' No example questions. A search-result summary (source page not identified; Shiksha Q&A returned 403) said the interview 'will take place at a regional interview centre and will be conducted by video call over the internet, estimated to take less than 30 minutes' — unverified. Contact: immigration@wrexham.ac.uk (from search summary).
